<!--
Thank you for contributing to Mondrian Framework!

Before opening:
- Run `npm run pretty && npm run build && npm test` locally
- For changes affecting a published package, run `npx changeset` and commit the generated file
- Link any related issues below
-->

## Summary

<!-- One paragraph: what changes and why. The reviewer should not have to read the diff to understand the goal. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing usage to fail)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup (no user-visible change)

## Affected package(s)

<!-- e.g. @mondrian-framework/model, @mondrian-framework/rest -->

## Related issues

<!-- Closes #1234, refs #5678 -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I have added tests covering the change (or explained below why this is not applicable)
- [ ] I have updated the relevant documentation under `packages/docs/`
- [ ] I have added a changeset (`npx changeset`) for any change to a published package
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run pretty` was run before committing

## Additional notes

<!-- Anything reviewers should know — design tradeoffs you considered, follow-up work, screenshots, benchmarks, etc. -->
